text: Authoritative graphics roadmap complete at b341c38. All 23 dependencies are closed: scale soundness, Tier 1/2/3 capabilities, scalar-field contours and topology-aware filled bands, all four backend contracts, platform metrics, canonical aesthetics, heterogeneous layers, measured guide layout, documented line ordering, and extraction readiness. Final evidence is the clean 213/210 core plus 24/21/12/11/7 backend matrix, a visually reviewed 41-case gallery, and successful repository-wide compileAll/testAll. The gate scored 10/10 against the bounded target rubric with no waivers; this remains an honest general plotting kernel rather than a claim of complete ggplot2 parity.
